description: This Java source file defines the MainActivity class for an Android application that demonstrates card emulation functionality. It manages UI components, menu options, and logging setup, including fragment transactions and view animations.

classes.name: MainActivity
classes.description: MainActivity is the primary activity for the sample app, managing UI components including a fragment for card emulation and logging functionalities.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, inflates the layout, and adds the CardEmulationFragment if savedInstanceState is null.

methods.name: onCreateOptionsMenu
methods.description: Inflates the options menu from resource.

methods.name: onPrepareOptionsMenu
methods.description: Configures the visibility and title of the toggle log menu item based on current UI state.

methods.name: onOptionsItemSelected
methods.description: Handles menu item selections, toggling the log display view.

methods.name: initializeLogging
methods.description: Sets up the logging chain, including wrapping, filtering, and on-screen log display.
